description: Draw your signature and stamp it onto any page of a PDF. Choose the page, position and size with sliders, then download the signed document.

faqs.a: No. This adds a drawn signature image to the document. It is not a certified cryptographic digital signature.
faqs.q: Is this a legally certified digital signature?

faqs.a: Use the X and Y sliders to move the signature, and the size slider to scale it. Position is a percentage of the page width and height.
faqs.q: How do I place the signature exactly where I want it?

faqs.a: Press and hold the mouse button (or your finger on touch screens) and write inside the white signature box, then click Sign.
faqs.q: How do I draw my signature?

howto: Choose a PDF file — its page count appears once loaded.
Draw your signature in the white box (mouse or touch), and clear it to retry.
Enter the page number and adjust the X, Y and size sliders.
Click "Sign & Download" to get your signed PDF.
title: eSign PDF
